digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM config resolution and layering
propositions: Add REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE naming a TOML file whose keys layer over the discovered config rather than replacing it.
Precedence is CLI -c llm.KEY > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default.
Nested tables must deep-merge so a pointed file overriding one leaf key preserves discovered sibling keys and fallback chains.
Arrays replace wholesale rather than append, and an empty array yields no entries.
The env var must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get so the static AST scanner documents it and the CI drift gate stays green.
read_reserved_section shallow-merge behavior must remain unchanged; deep merge is scoped to the llm resolver only.
